correctness.rationale: PASS: For noncomplete connected SRG (v,k,lambda,mu), adjacency A²=(k-mu)I+(lambda-mu)A+mu J gives L0²-SL0+mu v(I-J/v)=0 where S=2k-lambda+mu, nonzero eigenvalues q1,q2 sum to S and multiply to mu v. With t=ch, d(z)=1+z/2+z²/12, [2/2] Padé map is I-t L0 d(tL0)^-1. Rational interpolation at 0,q1,q2 yields edge coefficient t(1+mu t/2-mu(v-S)t²/12)/(d(tq1)d(tq2)) and nonedge coefficient mu t²(1/2+St/12)/den. Denominators>0, nonedges strictly positive t>0, diagonals strictly positive since Padé scalar numerator and denominator are positive for nonnegative spectrum and P is symmetric positive definite. Edge quadratic F(t) has unique positive zero precisely if Delta=v-S>0, producing H=(3/(c Delta))(1+sqrt(1+4 Delta/(3mu))); otherwise all steps positive. Strict beyond-endpoint negativity and asymptotic expansions follow from top-degree coefficients. Independent exact Fraction inversions and formula comparisons for Petersen, C5, triangular T5 and rook4 at t=1/2 agree entrywise.
